name: Singer and guitarist for welcome drinks: Tony Medina's song Headline
seoTitle: Tony Medina for welcome drinks: Headline
description: Tony Medina sings and plays guitar on Headline, one of his own songs. He mixes originals like this one in with his covers.
more: At an event, Tony usually sticks to covers, and we can work a few of his own songs in if you'd like them. Breathe In Deep and How Love Saved My Life are two more of his. On his own with an acoustic guitar, he's an easy pick for welcome drinks, patios and dinner.
